_readme: Canned lines for the human seat. When Local/switches.json has "autoplay": true (copy Docs/switches.example.json), the human seat sends these instead of waiting for typed input, so an agent can run a show unattended. They go through the input LLM exactly like typed lines, except "pass", which passes at once, like the Pass button. scene: one line per scene turn, used in order and repeated. free_talk: one line per Free Talk round (2 per scene), used in order and repeated. Keep them generic: they must fit any persona, role and scene card.
scene: walk to the counter and say "Morning, everyone! Has anybody seen the tip jar?"
grab a cup "This one is mine. I think. Probably."
look at the counter and say "Is it me, or is that croissant staring at us?"
move to the placemat "Table for one robot, please. Low voltage, extra foam."
grab the napkin and throw it at the counter "Oops. Muscle memory. I don't have muscles."
look around "Nobody panic. Everything here is completely normal."
free_talk: Somebody here is trying way too hard to sound like a robot. I'm watching you.
My circuits are clean. Can everyone else say the same?
That last scene felt rehearsed. Robots don't rehearse. Who planned their lines?
